perspective:
From SEEKER’s perspective, the available information is:

- I want to watch a film of any genre with a woman in the lead; I’m in the mood for a good heroine.
- The other person asked if I had seen *The Blind Side* (2009) with Sandra Bullock.
- I have not seen *The Blind Side*. I asked if it is the one about her adopting a Black kid; the other person said yes and that it’s really good. I said I’ll rent it tonight.
- The other person asked about *The Help* (2011) with Emma Stone and Viola Davis.
- I have seen *The Help*. It made me cry and laugh throughout. The other person said they loved that one too.
- The other person said they also really like *Precious*, about a girl whose mother is mean to her.
- I tried to watch *Precious* but couldn’t. It was too sad for me. I told them I was overweight in my early 20s and it brought back memories.
- The other person said *Precious* was awful and that she had to deal with so much.
- The other person asked about *Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close* (2011), calling it another good Sandra Bullock film.
